resources.string: Allow camera access to take an aquarium or profile photo. AquaLight only uses the camera when you start photo capture.
Camera access is currently blocked. Open AquaLight settings and enable Camera to continue taking photos.
Allow camera access so AquaLight can read the setup QR code. Camera frames are processed only for device setup.
Camera access is currently blocked. Open AquaLight settings and enable Camera to scan the device QR code.
Allow nearby-device access so AquaLight can find compatible devices during setup.
Nearby-device access is currently blocked. Open AquaLight settings and enable the required permission to scan for devices.
Allow Bluetooth connection access so AquaLight can securely configure the selected device.
Bluetooth connection access is currently blocked. Open AquaLight settings and enable the required permission to continue setup.
Allow nearby-device access so AquaLight can find and securely configure your device.
The permissions required for device setup are currently blocked. Open AquaLight settings and enable Nearby devices.
Android requires location permission to read the name of the Wi-Fi network currently connected to this phone. AquaLight uses it only to fill the network name during device setup.
Access to the current Wi-Fi network name is blocked. Open AquaLight settings and enable Location permission to fill the network automatically.
Allow notifications to receive aquarium-care reminders and important device alerts. You can change this later in App Settings.
Notifications are currently blocked by Android. Open notification settings and allow AquaLight notifications.
